## Overview

This directory contains Enterprise Standards for authoring AI coding assistant constructs — Skills, Agents, and Instruction files — across Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and OpenAI Codex. These standards implement the governance requirements established by [ADR-TEC-020](../../../decisions/technology/ADR-TEC-020-ai-coding-assistant-construct-taxonomy.md) (AI Coding Assistant Construct Taxonomy) and are informed by the alignment guidance in [GUID-TECH-IMPL-005](../../../strategy/guidance/technology/implementation/GUID-TECH-IMPL-005-ai-coding-assistant-construct-taxonomy-alignment.md).

## Standards in this Category

| Standard ID | Name | Description | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| [STD-TEC-AI-001](./STD-TEC-AI-001-skill-authoring.md) | AI Coding Assistant Skill Authoring Standard | SKILL.md structure, frontmatter, naming, scope, and quality criteria | Draft |
| [STD-TEC-AI-002](./STD-TEC-AI-002-agent-definition.md) | AI Coding Assistant Agent Definition Standard | .agent.md structure, tools declaration, scope boundaries, separation of duties | Draft |
| [STD-TEC-AI-003](./STD-TEC-AI-003-instruction-file.md) | AI Coding Assistant Instruction File Standard | copilot-instructions.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md structure, section ordering, cross-vendor parity | Draft |
| [STD-TEC-AI-004](./STD-TEC-AI-004-workflow-authoring.md) | AI Coding Assistant Workflow Authoring Standard | Command/Prompt authoring, naming, invocation boundaries, cross-vendor parity | Draft |
| [STD-TEC-AI-005](./STD-TEC-AI-005-file-pattern-instruction.md) | AI Coding Assistant File-Pattern Instruction Authoring Standard | Claude Code Rules, Copilot file-pattern Instructions, glob activation, cross-vendor parity | Draft |
| [STD-TEC-AI-006](./STD-TEC-AI-006-chat-driven-agent-standard.md) | AI Coding Assistant Chat-Driven Agent Standard | Chat-driven Agent recognition, task input contract, persona/routing structure, dual-mode requirements | Draft |
